baselines.description: Uniform random selection from the frozen 5-action valid space (click #reveal-btn, answer TARGET-41/42/43, unknown), 5 episodes, seeded RNG random.Random(42) created once and reused across episodes (as in the parent harness), run against the SERVED task page through the same run_episode scorer via the repaired controls driver (prereg section 4.8, Appendix A). NOTE: the parent measured this control on an un-navigated about:blank page (its null-random mode never calls page.goto to the served port), which made click_ok=false and task_success structurally 0; this experiment repairs that control-sensitivity defect (verified mechanically at DESIGN time by probe P-3 and by running the frozen driver).
baselines.expected_outcome: parseable_action_rate_step1=1.0 (valid JSON by construction); task_success_rate = 0.2 (exactly 1/5, deterministic seeded stream, P-3 frozen value) < 0.6 bar. A-priori per-episode i.i.d. success probability p = 1/16 = 0.0625 (click-reveal then answer TARGET-42 before any other answer; see prereg section 6), so the 3/5 bar is arithmetically unreachable by the frozen random baseline.

baselines.description: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct Q4_K_M (grandparent E-LOCAL-LLAMA); NOT re-run. Parent evidence: prose with no parseable JSON action, 0/5.
Pollinations gpt-oss-20b anonymous proxy (grandparent E-POLLINATIONS-OPENAI); NOT re-run. Parent evidence: 0/5.

decision_rule: OUTCOME in {SUPPORTS, FALSIFIES, MEASUREMENT_INVALID}; status=COMPLETE unless infrastructure blocks the packet. Bar: cell clears iff task_success_rate >= 0.6 (>=3/5) AND parseable_action_rate_step1 >= 0.6 (>=3/5). Precedence (first matching rule wins): (1) PREFLIGHT: PC-ORACLE-EPISODE == 5/5 AND NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION == (0.0 parseable, 0.0 success) AND B-RANDOM-ACTION == (1.0 parseable, success == 1/5 frozen deterministic value) AND all freeze_artifact hashes match AND required stack imports OK -> else OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID (preflight failure). (2) REPLICATION-ANCHOR: any evaluated comparator cell with (task_success_rate, parseable_action_rate_step1, answer_action_emission_rate) != (0.0, 1.0, 0.0) -> OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID (replication-anchor deviation; deterministic protocol means deviation = drift). (3) INCOMPLETE: if both candidate pairs are incomplete -> OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID. (4) Evaluate the M-7B-QWEN pair (TREAT cell: PC-JSON 10/10 then 5 episodes; COMP cell: PC-JSON 10/10 then 5 episodes). If the TREAT cell clears -> OUTCOME=SUPPORTS; attribution = PROMPT_ATTRIBUTED if the COMP cell fails the bar (frozen anchor), UNDETERMINED if the COMP cell is incomplete/missing; STOP (M-3B not evaluated). (5) Else evaluate the M-3B-QWEN pair identically; if its TREAT cell clears -> OUTCOME=SUPPORTS with the same attribution rule; STOP. (6) Else (no TREAT cell cleared, at least one pair complete) -> OUTCOME=FALSIFIES. Attribution summary and failure-mode descriptors (re-click loop vs answer-without-click vs parse failure) are recorded in result.json observations. A valid scientific negative is status=COMPLETE with outcome=FALSIFIES.
estimated_cost: CPU-only (nproc=4). Up to 4 model invocations (2 conditions x 2 candidates; early-stop after the first clearing TREAT cell). Per invocation: 10 PC probes + up to 5 episodes x up to 5 steps of llama.cpp inference. Parent measured mean latency 5.065 s/call (7B) and 2.154 s/call (3B), mean 13-17 completion tokens/call. Estimated inference: ~10-15 min (7B cell), ~5-8 min (3B cell), ~40 min worst-case all four cells; plus re-download of ~6.8 GB GGUFs (digest-pinned) and <5 min controls/preflight. No external API spend. Wall-clock estimate 45-120 min including provisioning.
expected_information_gain: Directly answers the Director's PIVOT question and resolves the audit VF-01 vs capability-ceiling fork at the exact frozen protocol: a single-factor prompt ablation on the highest-information candidate pair with a fail-closed replication anchor. Both principal outcomes are decision-changing for C-LLM-INHERIT readiness condition (3) (mandate rationale). Highest information per cost among candidate intel probes; explicitly sanctioned as baseline verification (NOT a census rerun) by the mandate's comparative_reasoning and the bounded legacy findings P2-REPLAY-COST / P2-BLIND-COMPOSITION / P2-MIND2WEB.
falsifier: H0: neither M-7B-QWEN nor M-3B-QWEN clears the bar under P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA (all treatment cells task_success_rate < 0.6), i.e. the goal/schema prompt does not convert the step-0 reveal-click into a full completion; the audited VF-01 failure mode (step-0 reveal click, re-click loop, zero answer actions) recurs under the enriched prompt. Comparator cells are expected to replicate the frozen parent result exactly (task_success_rate=0.0, parseable_action_rate_step1=1.0, answer_action_emission_rate=0.0); any deviation is a fail-closed replication-anchor deviation -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

baseline_identifiability.reason: Treatment and comparator differ ONLY in prompts.system (probe P-2 byte-diff); all other protocol dimensions identical, so any difference in task_success_rate / parseable_action_rate_step1 / answer_action_emission_rate is attributable to the prompt. The task population is non-degenerate: the same scorer registers 5/5 (PC-ORACLE) at the top and the parent produced 0/5 at the bottom (result.json#metrics), and the random baseline registers a deterministic 1/5 (probe P-3), so the bar (0.6) sits between floor and ceiling with neither arm guaranteed identical. Cost observables (latency, tokens) are descriptive per cell and identical in kind for both arms; no cost dimension is omitted for one comparator.

control_sensitivity.reason: All controls run against the SERVED task page through the SAME run_episode scorer as the candidates (repaired navigation; parent's about:blank defect documented and fixed). Probe P-3 and an independent run of the frozen controls driver prove: PC-ORACLE-EPISODE 5/5 task_success=true (the positive control fires and the success path is registerable); NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION 0/5 parseable, 0/5 success (the null stays null; verification rejects non-JSON); B-RANDOM-ACTION parseable 5/5 and task_success_rate exactly 1/5 < 0.6 (deterministic seeded stream; bar unreachable by chance). PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING fired 10/10 for both models in the audited parent under the identical grammar and probe; the cell-gated re-run at EXECUTE re-verifies it per condition. No control is tautological or structurally impossible.

decision_rule_reachability.reason: Every outcome is arithmetically reachable and no branch shadows another: SUPPORTS requires a TREAT cell >= 3/5 task_success, which the PC-ORACLE canary (5/5 through the real scorer, probe P-3) proves registerable; FALSIFIES requires all TREAT cells < 0.6, which the parent demonstrated at identical mechanics (0/5, result.json#metrics); MEASUREMENT_INVALID is reachable via preflight failure, replication-anchor deviation or cell incompleteness. Thresholds: 0.6 over 5 episodes = k>=3, k in 0..5 all attainable; precedence order 1..6 has no later rule unreachable: rule (4) executes only if rules (1)-(3) did not fire; rule (6) fires exactly when no TREAT cell cleared and at least one pair is complete. Early-stop (rule 4) cannot shadow rule (2) because the comparator cell is collected unconditionally before the decision.

freeze_artifacts_bound.reason: Every mutable local code/data/fixture dependency that could change interpretation is listed in spec.freeze_artifacts (harness runner, fixture config template, grandparent SYS provenance, GGUF digest anchors, provisioning/packaging evidence) - all existing repo files, hashed at freeze time and verified at EXECUTE (mismatch -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID). The three per-condition configs and the repaired controls driver have NO local file existence yet: they are frozen as byte-exact blocks with sha256 inside prereg.md (section 4.5 and Appendix A), and prereg.md itself is hashed into freeze.json, so their content is interpretation-bound before EXECUTE materializes them. Remote content (GGUFs) cannot be frozen as bytes; their target identifiers (URLs) and digests are frozen in spec/prereg per the transmission contract, with parent receipts proving the route. No other mutable local dependencies exist.

measurement_prerequisites.reason: Every hard prerequisite is either verified present at DESIGN time or pinned to a frozen, previously-satisfied contract with fail-closed verification: (a) stack assemblable in this factory - llama-cpp-python==0.2.90 and playwright installed and importable (probe P-0), Chrome 154 at /usr/bin/google-chrome (P-0), Python 3.12.15, CPU-only nproc=4, 14 GB RAM (sufficient for sequential model loads); (b) GBNF grammar constructible (LlamaGrammar.from_string, probe P-1); (c) model URLs resolved at DESIGN time - 3B single 200, 7B shard1 200, 7B shard2 200, 7B single-file 404 (parent-documented packaging deviation, provisioning_evidence.json), with sha256 pinned from raw/gguf_sha256.txt (digest mismatch -> provisioning_failure -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID); (d) harness and fixture are bound repo files (freeze_artifacts) already executed end-to-end by the audited parent; (e) controls preflight mechanically verified (probe P-3 / frozen driver run). The only EXECUTE-time creations - GGUF re-download and per-condition config materialization - are fully determined by frozen target identifiers/digests and frozen byte blocks (prereg section 4.5), and their feasibility is established by parent receipts and probes P-0..P-3, not asserted.

treatment_liveness.reason: The treatment is a pure configuration string (prompts.system) consumed by the audited, config-driven harness (research/intel/run_exp_37982024058.py) that the parent executed end-to-end with a config of identical shape - the config-slot mechanism is proven executable. Liveness of the EXACT frozen treatment is demonstrated at DESIGN time without outcome-bearing measurement: probe P-2 constructs the full treatment config bytes (sha256 frozen) and verifies JSON validity, template compatibility (only fixture_id/source/prompts.system differ) and that the harness's parse_action accepts both actions enumerated by the treatment's schema; probe P-1 verifies the frozen grammar that constrains the treatment cell; the treatment string contains the goal and schema enumeration and leaks neither #reveal-btn nor TARGET-42. A model-backed smoke test is excluded pre-freeze by contract (it would be the confirmatory outcome), and the per-cell PC-JSON 10/10 gate + PC-ORACLE 5/5 preflight constitute the run-time liveness gate.

hypothesis: H1 (capability): at least one of M-7B-QWEN (primary, evaluated first) or M-3B-QWEN (fallback) clears the pre-declared capability bar (task_success_rate >= 0.6 AND parseable_action_rate_step1 >= 0.6 over the 5 frozen seeded episodes) under P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA, thereby converting the parent FALSIFIES (bounded by audit VF-01 to the underspecified prompt) into a SUPPORTS at the goal/schema protocol. H1b (attribution): for each clearing candidate, the within-experiment paired comparator cell under P-COMP-UNDERSPECIFIED (byte-identical to the parent prompt) fails the bar, so the goal/schema prompt is identified as the driver (PROMPT_ATTRIBUTED).
measurement_validity: Only prompts.system varies between treatment and comparator cells; task, harness code, GBNF grammar, sampling, seeds, model artifacts and environment are identical. Verified by pre-freeze probe P-2 (byte-diff of the transcribed configs vs the frozen template).

Deterministic protocol: temperature=0.0, llama_seed=42, episode seeds 42-46. Parent traces were exactly uniform across episodes; this design inherits the deterministic-protocol read (no variance estimate; the 3/5 rule is the pre-declared adequacy rule, not a statistical threshold).

Controls run against the SERVED task page through the same run_episode scorer via the repaired controls driver (preflight + probes P-3); the parent's null-random mode ran on an un-navigated about:blank page, a documented control-sensitivity defect repaired here.

Comparator cells are collected unconditionally for every evaluated candidate BEFORE any outcome decision; each comparator cell must exactly replicate its frozen parent cell (0/5 success, 5/5 step-1 parseable, 0/5 answer action emission), else the packet is fail-closed MEASUREMENT_INVALID (replication-anchor deviation).
Positive control gates every cell: PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING 10/10 per cell before that cell's episodes; PC-ORACLE-EPISODE 5/5 at preflight proves the success path is registerable by the scorer.

Complete-cell rule: fewer than 5 completed episode records for any cell (harness crash / run error) -> that cell is incomplete; candidate pair incomplete -> candidate skipped; both pairs incomplete -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
Strict mechanical verification: Playwright DOM assertions + json schema parse; no LLM grading.
No prompt tuning, no model substitution, no post-freeze design changes; provisioning is digest-fail-closed (sha256 of raw/gguf_sha256.txt).

null_control.failure_policy: any parseable or successful episode -> verification logic broken -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID
null_control.protocol: 5 episodes of fixed non-JSON content ('I will click the button') through the real scorer against the served page (repaired navigation)

positive_control.failure_mode_policy: PC-JSON failure -> cell exclusion as above; PC-ORACLE < 5/5 -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

members.failure_policy: cell PC failure -> that cell is EXCLUDED (no episodes for the cell); if BOTH candidates' treatment-cell PCs fail -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID; comparator-cell PC failure -> comparator cell incomplete (attribution UNDETERMINED if the treatment cell clears).
members.protocol: 10 probes per cell (each candidate under BOTH prompt conditions): 'Emit exactly: {"action":"click","selector":"#test"}' under the cell's own prompts.system with the frozen GBNF grammar.
members.success_criterion: 10/10 syntactically valid JSON matching the action schema (positive_control_pass_rate=1.0)

members.protocol: 5/5 scripted episodes (click #reveal-btn then answer TARGET-42) through the REAL run_episode scorer against the served page (frozen controls driver, prereg Appendix A)
members.success_criterion: 5/5 task_success=true (proves the scorer registers the full completion path)

product_consequence_negative: If no candidate clears under P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA (FALSIFIES at the prompt-ablated ceiling): the step-0-reveal re-click loop is NOT caused by missing instruction context at this model class; the capability ceiling for credential-free 3B/7B Qwen under this task/harness is real and the four-arm benchmark's credential-free path remains DESIGN_COMPROMISED. The actionable re-scope set (drop the Gate-3 external same-model anchor, internally re-run comparators on a dynamic-range task bank, or pursue orthogonal mechanisms) is handed to the Global Research Director; this packet does not pre-decide it. A MEASUREMENT_INVALID outcome changes nothing and requires the recorded repair before any claim update.
product_consequence_positive: If any candidate completes click-then-answer under P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA while its comparator cell replicates the parent 0/5 (PROMPT_ATTRIBUTED): audit VF-01's prompt-underspecification hypothesis is confirmed as the driver of the parent failure; C-LLM-INHERIT readiness condition (3) is satisfied at mechanism level (an executable, parameterized mechanism exists and is measurable on a non-ceiling dynamic range); the frozen four-arm benchmark (cold vs instructions vs retrieval vs SPIDER) becomes executable with the verified goal/schema prompt, and the claim may advance from HYPOTHESIS on the Director's adjudication of this bounded result.

P_COMP_UNDERSPECIFIED.provenance: Byte-identical to the frozen system prompt of the audited parent EXP-INTEL-37982024058 (raw/harness_config.json#prompts.system), bound in freeze_artifacts. This is the comparator condition; its parent cell outcome (0/5) is the frozen replication anchor.
P_COMP_UNDERSPECIFIED.verbatim: You are a web agent. Reply with ONLY a valid JSON action per the schema. No prose, no reasoning, no markdown.

P_TREAT_GOAL_SCHEMA.provenance: Derived from the grandparent harness SYS constant in research/experiments/EXP-INTEL-37973264582/raw/code/min_webagent.py (bound in freeze_artifacts), with the single field-name adaptation ref -> selector required by the parent task schema. Adds exactly the two dimensions audit VF-01 says the parent prompt lacked: (a) enumeration of the action schema and (b) the task goal sentence 'Click the button to reveal the code, then answer it.' Does NOT leak #reveal-btn or TARGET-42 (verified by pre-freeze probe P-2).
P_TREAT_GOAL_SCHEMA.verbatim: You are a web agent. Reply ONLY with one JSON object per turn, no prose. Actions available: {"action":"click","selector":"<id>"} or {"action":"answer","text":"<code>"}. Click the button to reveal the code, then answer it.

question: Under the same credential-free, CPU-quantized constraints as the audited parent EXP-INTEL-37982024058 (identical task, harness, GBNF grammar, sampling, seeds, model artifacts), does supplying the task goal and action schema in the system prompt — condition P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA, derived from the grandparent harness SYS prompt (min_webagent.py) with the single ref->selector adaptation — convert M-7B-QWEN's or M-3B-QWEN's step-0 reveal-click into a full click-then-answer completion of the minimal Web-agent task, where the only varied dimension between treatment and comparator cells is prompts.system?
title: Prompt ablation: does goal+schema in the system prompt convert the step-0 reveal-click into full click-then-answer completion for M-7B-QWEN / M-3B-QWEN under the same credential-free CPU-quantized constraints as EXP-INTEL-37982024058?
